en.saveFailed: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
en.subagentCapacityHelp: Total live Subagents under the same main Agent, across all recursion levels. The main Agent is excluded. New start requests are rejected when the limit is reached.
en.subagentCapacityInvalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
en.subagentDepthHelp: Limits how many levels of Subagents an Agent can create.
en.subagentDepthInvalid: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
en.subagentDepthOne: Only the main Agent can create Subagents
en.subagentDepthOverride: If a tool defines its own maximum recursion depth, that setting takes precedence.
en.subagentDescription: Set Subagent recursion depth, count, and models.
en.subagentModelSelectionChoose: When enabled, agents can choose a provider, model, and reasoning effort for each Subagent from the authorized models below. Applies only to new sessions.
en.subagentModelSelectionConflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Discard your draft and try again.
en.subagentModelSelectionEmpty: No model provider currently advertises a model.
en.subagentModelSelectionOff: Subagents use configured defaults or inherit the parent agent's model. Saved model choices are retained.
en.subagentModelSelectionPartial: Some model providers could not be loaded; saved choices remain removable.
en.subagentModelSelectionRequired: Select at least one model before saving.
en.subagentModelSelectionToggle: Allow agents to choose models for Subagents
en.unavailable: This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now.
